description: Details required by condition 3b, c, e, f, h and j (Submission of details - b) Notwithstanding the approved drawings, new fire surrounds at a scale of 1:10; c) Following careful investigation, extent and form of alteration to existing ceilings, including any new decorative plasterwork; e) Following careful investigation, extent and form of alterations to existing joinery, including doors, architraves and skirtings; f) All new internal joinery, including doors, architraves and skirtings, with elevations and sections at a scale of 1:10; h) Any new hard flooring, including section at a scale of 1:10; and (j) Full schedule of repairs to existing facades.) of listed building consent 22/05030 (Refurbishment and extension of the existing listed building to provide a third-floor mansard, rebuilding over the existing side extension and the erection of a three-storey rear/side extension at ground to third floor levels plus mansard roof providing 3 new residential units (2x2-bed and 1x studio) (Class C3), extension to existing residential unit, an additional basement and associated internal and external refurbishment works.)
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
